label: Noir Detective
name: noir
plan_intro: Thirty days. Four leads worth following. Work them in order and don't skip the boring ones; the boring ones are where the truth hides.
signoff: Case stays open until the record improves. It always improves, or it always closes. Your move.

verdicts.A: The record was clean. Too clean, I almost said. Then I read it twice. It held up.
verdicts.B: A solid record in a city of flimsy ones. A few smudges on the glass, nothing more.
verdicts.C: The commits told a story. Half of it was missing, and the other half was in a hurry.
verdicts.D: I've seen this file before. Different name, same 2am timestamps, same one-word confessions.
verdicts.F: The record didn't just have gaps. It had alibis, and none of them checked out.
